parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under paths that are sample/example app entry points: `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` (the `WXUISampleApp.body` computed property in the `WXUI` package's `Examples/` subtree) and `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift` (the `PlayerHeaderViewApp.body` computed property in the `PlayerHeaderView` package). These are boilerplate SwiftUI `App`-protocol `body` properties that each mini-app must declare independently; their structural identity is a consequence of the SwiftUI entry-point pattern, not a sign of unintended duplication. Merging them would conflate two distinct runnable targets that exist to preview/demo separate components.
